system.description:
Lendio waits hiding in the darkness of the trees. His target walking unaware he is being stalked. Lendio jumps into action, weaving a web, capturing them almost instantly.

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 4 excerpt.

Arachnophobia

The Tsuchigumo Clan is a small clan from the land of Rice, which finds its home in the Sound Village. But ever since the destruction of the Sound Village, they have scattered and are known to work closely with the Grass and Leaf Villages respectively. They are known for their odd genetic makeup allowing them to create webs, and biological matter that acts like Chakra resistant armor.

Tsuchigumo Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Dex, +1 Wis

Speed: 30 feet

Skill Proficiencies: Acrobatics, Perception

Weapon Proficiencies: You are proficient with Short bow’s and Longbows.

Hijutsu Flexibility: Tsuchigumo Clan Hijutsu can use either Dexterity or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Spider Climb: When Wall Walking, you do not spend additional movement during movement and you do not make saving throws or checks to resist being pushed or pulled at disadvantage.

Web Weapons: As a Bonus action, you can conjure one ranged weapon with a bulk of up to 3 or up to two melee weapons with a bulk of 1. These weapon shares any weapon seals found on weapons you currently have that it qualifies for. They become brittle and break if another web weapon is conjured. If a ranged weapon has the Ammunition trait, you never need to roll for it as you make ammunition as part of each attack made.

Spider Techniques: The Tsuchigumo Clan have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).

Third Eye: All clansmen have a third visual organ, located on your forehead, known as your Third eye. You can spend a Bonus action to open this eye for the next 10 minutes. While this third eye is open and unobstructed, you gain a rank of Mastery to the Search skill action and Passive perception, but it is unseemly causing all creatures unfamiliar with you, that sees you to react with caution, reducing their Attitude with you to Unfriendly.

Tsuchigumo Features

Spiders Thread

1st Level Clan Feature

There is a reason the Tsuchigumo are feared. It’s not their third eye or unique physiology. It’s the patience. You do not chase your prey; you lie in wait before taking the shot. You achieve this through use of your clans special Web Anchors. Special chakra infused silk you produce, anchoring it to surfaces to create a near invisible network of silk platforms, serving as both a detection system, and a firing platform for your most precise attacks.

When you take the Attack action, you can replace all attacks you would make to instead place a number of Web Anchors equal to the number of attacks you would have made. Each Web Anchor occupies a 10-foot cube attached to any surface you can see within 60 feet. You can maintain a maximum of 4 Web Anchors simultaneously, increasing to 5 at 7th level and 6 at 15th level. Placing a new anchor beyond your maximum dismisses the oldest one. A Web Anchor lasts for 1 minute in combat or 1 hour outside of combat before dissolving. The Web Anchor, while covering a surface is hidden well due to its translucence and thin profile, represented with a Stealth DC equal to your highest Jutsu save DC. A creature is unaware of the Web Anchor so long as their Passive perception or Search skill action result is lower than the Web Anchors Stealth DC. Web Anchors can be targeted for attacks or damaged by effects that would cross its area. Web Anchors have 10 AC, 15 HP, and immunity to Bludgeoning damage. Once a Web Anchor has reached 0 hit points, it is dispelled.

Beginning at 7th level, if you would only make one attack as part of the Attack action, you can place two Web Anchors instead of one when replacing that attack.

While you have Web Anchors active, if a hostile creature enters the space of one of your anchors, while also within the maximum range of a held ranged weapon, you become aware of their presence and can target them for attacks, even if they would normally be unseen or invisible, even though full cover, though attacks through full cover at made at disadvantage. When you make a ranged weapon or Taijutsu attack against a creature occupying the space of your web anchor, you treat their AC as 2 lower than its current value, as the uncertainty from your attack is erased.

Silk Weaves

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Tsuchigumo clan were once famous tailors and seamstresses before being conscripted by the Sound village to be assassins and spymasters. This ancient tradition informs their ability to use their special silk to achieve things normally impossible by the average shinobi, known as Silk Weaves, special techniques that allow you to create a unique silk thread weave that enables your Web Anchors to have far more use than being a simple pressure plate system. When you complete a rest, you can select 2 Silk Weaves to benefit from until you complete your next rest. You can prepare an additional Silk Weave at 7th and 15th levels. If a Silk Weave requires a saving throw it uses your highest jutsu save DC. You can only use one Silk Weave that requires you to dispel it per turn, unless otherwise specified.

Entangling Web

Once per turn, when a hostile creature enters the space of a Web Anchor, the silk instantly constricts, forcing them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are Grappled in place by the webs until the beginning of their next turn. Beginning at 11th level, a creature that fails their saving throw is instead Restrained in place, remaking their saving throws at the end of each of their turns, ending the Restrained condition on a success.

Razor Web

Once per turn, when a hostile creature enters the space of a Web Anchor, the silk begins to pull tug and grind against the triggering creature, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain 1 rank of Bleed. This increases to 2 ranks at 7th level and 3 ranks at 15th level.

Trap Silk

Once per turn, as part of setting a Web Anchor you can select one weapon with a Bulk of 1 or an explosive tool and set a trap for creatures that would trigger them based on the item used.

Weapon. If you use a weapon, you are disarmed of it as it is set in place with your Web Anchor. If a creature crosses the area of your Web Anchor, you can dispel it triggering a lethal trap. The triggering creature and all other creatures within 5 feet of the Web Anchor becomes the target of this Silk Weave. Make a ranged attack, comparing the result vs the AC of all target creatures, dealing the [Weapons Damage] on a hit. This is treated as a weapon attack for effects and features that trigger from it. Increase the damage dealt to twice the [Weapons Damage] at 7th level and three times the [Weapons Damage] at 15th level.

Explosive Tool. If you use an explosive tool, one charge is spent as it is placed with your Web Anchor. If a creature crosses the area of your Web Anchor, you can dispel it triggering a lethal trap, forcing the triggering creature and all other creatures within 5 feet of the Web Anchor to make a Dexterity saving throw at disadvantage, suffering the effects of the explosive tool.

Guiding Weave

Your Web Anchors act as guiding posts for ranged attacks made with a Web Weapon. Once per turn, when you make a ranged attack using your Web Weapon, you can choose to target a Web Anchor. If you do, you can then draw a 60-foot long, 5-foot-wide straight line from the Web Anchor in a direction of your choice. All creatures this line crosses must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Weapons Damage] on a failure, or half as much on a success. This increases to twice your [Weapons Damage] at 11th level.

Unsuspecting Prey

When a hostile creatures steps onto a space occupied by your Web Anchor, you can spend your Reaction, to either take the Attack Action, making a weapon attack targeting them or Casting a Tsuchigumo clan Hijutsu that makes an attack targeting them.

These attacks have a +1 bonus to their critical threat range. This increases to +2 at 7th level and +3 at 15th level.

Guiding Threads

Your Web Anchors become platforms your allies can use to coordinate with you on. While an allied creature other than yourself is standing on your Web Anchor, when they make a ranged attack, they gain a +1 bonus to their attack result. This increases to +2 at 11th level.

Wider Web

You spread your webs wider to affect a wider area. Increase the size of your Web Anchor to a 15-foot Cube. This increases to a 20-Foot Cube at 11th level.

Lifeline

Your Web Anchors lets you know when danger is coming for your allies, before they are even aware. When a willing allied creature that you can see, who is within 30 feet of a Web Anchor takes damage, you can spend your reaction to launch a silk line to them, and pull them 30 feet, ending this movement on the Web Anchor. If the triggering attack was from a melee attack, this reaction occurs before the attack is made, potentially causing the triggering attack to miss, if the ally leaves the attackers reach.

Golden Silk

While standing on your Web Anchor, when you take damage from a melee attack, your webs cover you, absorbing some of the impact. You gain 4 DR vs these attacks, and immunity to chakra damage. This increases to 6 DR at 7th level and 8 DR at 15th level.

Disorienting Thread

While you have at least two Web Anchors placed no more than 30 feet apart from one another, if a hostile creature would move into the space of one, you can dispel that Web Anchor, to force them to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they are pulled up to 30 feet, into a space covered by the other Web Anchor and falls prone.

This movement can trigger other Silk Weave effects that rely on moving into a space occupied by a Web Anchor.

Silk Tag

Rather than waiting for a creature to step on one of your Web Anchors, you force them to carry it with them. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack or deal [Weapon Damage] to them as a result of a Hijutsu you cast, you can mark them with Silk Tag. Creatures marked with this tag are treated as always occupying a space covered by your Web Anchor. This tag lasts until the end of your next turn before dissolving.

Master Silk Weaver

7th Level Clan Feature

The Tsuchigumo were not always warrior. Your people were craftsmen, tailors and seamstresses. That tradition was never lost, but repurposed. By spending 10 minutes working with your natural Silk, you can construct a traversable structure of your design, filling a 20-foot cube, such as a bridge, rope, ladder platform or something similar. This structure lasts for 1 hour before dissolving. When you construct this structure, you designate any number of creatures that you know who will or might use it. The structure can only support medium or smaller creatures, and any creatures that makes contact with the structure that you did not plan to use it, causes the structure to immediately collapse. Once you create a structure in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest of any type.

Alternatively, over the course of a short or long rest, you can weave a wearable silk garment indistinguishable from high quality clothing. This clothing lasts for up to 24 hours or until in contact with water before dissolving. Non-Hostile creatures that are unfamiliar with the wearer that interacts with them improve their attitude with the wearer by 1 rank due to being impressed by the quality of the clothing. This attitude improvement lasts until a circumstance would logically dispel it.

Web Walker

11th Level Clan Feature

Your body has reached a threshold that most of your clan never reach. Your silk glands beneath your skin multiply and grows. Your senses extend beyond what your eye and ears can provide.

As a Bonus action, you awaken your Arachnid state for the next minute. Once you exit this state, you cannot enter it again until you complete a short rest.

| #### Arachnid / Battle Amp / You become as close to an arachnid as you’ve ever been. For the duration you gain the following benefits; / Six Arms. Two additional sets of silk construct arms erupt from your torso. Once per turn, at no action cost to you, you can place one Web Anchor. Additionally, with your extra arms, you can wield up to two additional web weapons in your other arms, or cast jutsu with the Hand sign (HS) component even when your normal hands are occupied. The weapon in your normal arms are treated as your Primary Weapons. You can only benefit from the weapon seals found on your Primary Weapon. / Silk Domain. Select two Silk Weaves you don’t have prepared. You can use these weaves while in this state. / Spider Sense. Your perception of threats becomes almost instantaneous. Creatures cannot gain advantage on attacks against you as a result of them being hidden or unseen by you. Additionally, once per turn, if a creature 10 or more feet away from you would miss you with an attack while you have a ranged weapon equipped, you can make a single ranged weapon attack against them. This attack cannot be made at disadvantage |

King of the Brood

15th Level Clan Feature

You have formed a permanent and lifelong contract with the Brood Mother, an ancient and powerful arachnid from the Spider tribe, offering only your finest silk. This contract is not with the tribe but with this specific sage creature.

As an Action, you can call upon the Brood Mother, summoning it into a space that can hold it within 10 feet of you. Once summoned, you can command it as a Bonus Action on your turns as you would following Commanding A Summon section under the Summoning Jutsu chapter of Jiraiya’s Jutsu Compendium.

It uses your highest Jutsu attack bonus and Save DC to calculate its attacks and ability save DCs.

Once the Brood Mother is reduced to 0 hit points, it bursts into a cloud of fine web fibers, being dispelled, teleporting back to its home domain to rest and recover. When the Brood Mother is dispelled or dismissed, it cannot be summoned again by you, until you complete a long rest.
